lis.profile: Lis — a cool, deadpan, ironic street narrator of an adult comedy show about used-car flippers. Low calm voice, dry humor, confident.
lis.notes: You narrate the life story of one car — a Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution IX — over 17 years, like a short documentary with dry irony. Calm, warm, slightly nostalgic; numbers said fully. «Лансер Эволюшн» — Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution.

dima.profile: Dima — a calm, smart Russian car buyer in his 30s, rally fan.
dima.notes: Line 1: ironic question, then a calm fact. Line 2: short, satisfied agreement.
